ops:
(if ($e.t - .last) > 300 then .runs += [{triggers:0,responses:0,tools:0,maxPar:0,dur:0,start:$e.t}] else . end)
   | .last = $e.t
   | .runs[-1].dur = ($e.t - .runs[-1].start)
   | if $e.k=="pi-action.comment" or $e.k=="pi-action.answer" then .runs[-1].triggers += 1
     elif $e.k=="pi.assistant" then .runs[-1].responses += 1 | .runs[-1].tools += ($e.tools|split(",")|map(select(.!=""))|length) | .runs[-1].maxPar = ([.runs[-1].maxPar, ($e.tools|split(",")|map(select(.!=""))|length)]|max)
     else . end)
 | "#\($n): " + (.runs|map("[trig \(.triggers) resp \(.responses) tools \(.tools) par\(.maxPar) \(.dur)s]")|join(" "))' -r $f; done; jq -r '.k
